title: 小さな落下が津波に

candidates.headline: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21
candidates.angle: Illustrate how a tiny technical slip can magnify into an uncontrollable exposure: a minuscule object becomes the seed of an enormous, destructive leak.
candidates.title: 小さな落下が津波に
candidates.scene: A tired desk clerk in a police office accidentally drops a single small USB stick onto the floor. At the point where it hits, a tiny damp circle forms and then explosively swells into a towering wave made of loose printed documents, loose USBs and discs that surges through the open station door. Two uniformed officers are swept off their feet on pieces of floating paper; one frantically tries to prop a small sandbag against the approaching wall of documents. The scene makes the small object the origin of an enormous physical flood.
candidates.reason: 微細なミスや脆弱点が、瞬く間に制御不能な大規模露出へと拡大することを、スケールの急拡大で視覚化することで見せる。
candidates.visualTurn: scale_shift: a tiny dropped device is visually amplified into a colossal, overwhelming flood of documents, turning a minor lapse into a massive disaster.
candidates.contradiction: Although the police fear a 'leak', the cartoon shows how a small mishap can scale far beyond containment and how their on-the-spot measures are comically insufficient.
candidates.evidence: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21

evaluation.reason: 微細なミスや脆弱点が、瞬く間に制御不能な大規模露出へと拡大することを、スケールの急拡大で視覚化することで見せる。
unsupportedClaims: 流出の原因が『現場で落とされたUSBメモリ』のような単一の小さな物理ミスであるという特定の因果関係（記事は『恐れ』を伝えているが、具体的原因の記述はない）

candidates.headline: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21
candidates.angle: Expose the gap between claimed security and visible exposure by turning a 'secure' container into something transparently revealing.
candidates.title: 中身が丸見えの金庫
candidates.scene: A records room dominated by a large heavy cabinet that would normally imply security. The cabinet is made of clear glass: inside are neat stacks of documents, identity photos and ID cards plainly visible and already spilling up to the cabinet door. A uniformed officer frantically tries to drape a tarp over the cabinet while another stands by with a helpless expression. The cabinet is the dominant prop and clearly displays its contents to anyone in the room.
candidates.reason: 『安全な保管』を象徴する金庫が透けて中身をさらす設定で、守るはずの個人情報が逆に露出している皮肉を直截に示す。
candidates.visualTurn: reveal: an object meant to conceal (a secure cabinet) literally reveals the private information it is supposed to hide, making the promised protection visually void.
candidates.contradiction: A device intended to secure personal records openly displays them, undermining the claim of protection by turning the safeguard into a display case.
candidates.evidence: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21

evaluation.reason: 『安全な保管』を象徴する金庫が透けて中身をさらす設定で、守るはずの個人情報が逆に露出している皮肉を直截に示す。
unsupportedClaims: 捜査支援システム／警察の記録が物理的に『金庫（キャビネット）』という形で保管されており、その金庫が現場で開放・露出しているという具体的事実

candidates.headline: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21
candidates.angle: Show the absurdity of police panic by visually reversing custody: ordinary citizens become the on-the-ground guardians of sensitive police files while officers offload responsibility.
candidates.title: 市民がファイルを守る
candidates.scene: A police station hallway where two uniformed officers are carrying heavy locked boxes labeled only by their shape (no small text). Instead of putting them in a vault, the officers hand the boxes to a small group of ordinary civilians — an elderly woman, a delivery worker — who sit cross-legged in a ring around the boxes, sitting vigilantly as if on guard. One officer stands empty-handed, looking relieved and nervously gesturing back toward the station, while another scratches his head, watching the citizens who now physically hold the files.
candidates.reason: 個人情報の漏えいを恐れる警察が、守る側と守られる側を入れ替えている様子をそのまま描くことで、期待される役割と現実の逆転を批評する。
candidates.visualTurn: role_reversal: before — police are custodians of records; after — civilians physically hold and guard the boxes while police hand them over and appear relieved or exposed.
candidates.contradiction: The institutions expected to protect citizens' data are depicted offloading custody to ordinary people, reversing the expected protector/protected relationship.
candidates.evidence: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21

evaluation.reason: 個人情報の漏えいを恐れる警察が、守る側と守られる側を入れ替えている様子をそのまま描くことで、期待される役割と現実の逆転を批評する。
unsupportedClaims: 警察が実際に市民にファイルの保管を委ねている（警察が市民に箱を手渡した／責任を放棄したという具体的事実）

exploredCandidates.headline: 1. スペースXとテスラ統合協議 イーロン・マスク氏が委員会設置を表明（日経、ブルームバーグ、AXIOS等）2026/10/21
exploredCandidates.angle: He announces a formal committee to oversee a merger — yet the two flagship products physically resist being merged, exposing a practical mismatch beneath corporate language.
exploredCandidates.title: ロケットに車は入らない
exploredCandidates.scene: A small solemn 'Integration Committee' of suited executives sits at a long table labeled 'Committee' and studies blueprints; behind them, a SpaceX rocket and a Tesla car stand nose-to-nose like dating partners at an awkward distance while a committee member tries to wedge the car into the rocket's nosecone with a giant measuring tape and a wooden mallet.
exploredCandidates.reason: 委員会設置という形式的対応と、両社製品の実際の非互換性の対比を一枚で示すため。
exploredCandidates.visualTurn: The committee's decision-making is literalized: instead of charts, committee work becomes the physical, futile act of trying to force a car into a rocket nosecone, revealing incompatibility.
exploredCandidates.contradiction: He forms a committee to 'integrate' two companies, while the companies' core products visibly cannot be merged.
exploredCandidates.evidence: スペースXとテスラ統合協議 イーロン・マスク氏が委員会設置を表明

exploredCandidates.headline: 2. AIバブルは「ほぼ間違いない」、シタデル創業者ケン・グリフィン氏（ブルームバーグ、AI関連）2026/10/21
exploredCandidates.angle: A leading financier publicly warns that an AI bubble is nearly certain — while the market-bubble itself behaves as if indifferent to the warning, amplifying the dissonance between caution and frenzy.
exploredCandidates.title: 警告を叫ぶ男と叫ぶ泡
exploredCandidates.scene: Ken Griffin stands on a small riser holding a warning placard and addressing a crowd; towering over him is an enormous translucent 'AI' bubble wearing sunglasses and holding a megaphone that blasts 'BUY BUY' back at him, while tiny investors inside the bubble cheer.
exploredCandidates.reason: 発言者の警告と言葉と、市場（泡）がそれを無視して加速する対立を可視化するため。
exploredCandidates.visualTurn: Instead of the speaker controlling the market, the anthropomorphic bubble answers back with a megaphone and steers investor enthusiasm, reversing who 'speaks' to whom.
exploredCandidates.contradiction: He warns that an AI bubble is almost certain, yet the bubble itself is shown loudly promoting buying and drowning out the warning.
exploredCandidates.evidence: AIバブルは「ほぼ間違いない」、シタデル創業者ケン・グリフィン氏

exploredCandidates.headline: 3. パリなどフランス各地に夜間外出禁止令 週末の暴動受け（国内etc）2026/10/21
exploredCandidates.angle: A night curfew meant to stop street unrest instead relocates the riot energies into domestic settings, exposing how prohibition changes form without eliminating the underlying tension.
exploredCandidates.title: 枕で暴れる夜
exploredCandidates.scene: A street curfew sign blocks a boulevard at dusk; behind the sign, instead of empty streets, apartment windows glow with people in pajamas staging a pillow-and-blanket mock-riot — toy Molotovs made of pillows, broomstick 'batons,' and a banner hung from a balcony reading 'We riot tonight.'
exploredCandidates.reason: 外出禁止という規制が、暴動を外から内へ“変形”させる予想外の帰結を表現するため。
exploredCandidates.visualTurn: The outlawed street riot is visually relocated indoors: the public ban pushes the performance of the unrest into living rooms and balconies, showing the curfew changes the location but not the energy.
exploredCandidates.contradiction: Authorities ban nighttime outings to stop riots, yet the unrest reappears inside homes and windows under the cover of the curfew.
exploredCandidates.evidence: パリなどフランス各地に夜間外出禁止令 週末の暴動受け

exploredCandidates.angle: Netflix pinned hopes on advertising to boost revenues, but the ad business is underperforming, turning the promised financial lifeline into a trickle.
exploredCandidates.title: 穴の空いた自販機
exploredCandidates.scene: A giant vending machine shaped like a streaming TV kiosk labeled 'Ads Revenue' stands onstage; executives watch coins dribble out of it in a slow trickle while a huge poster behind reads 'Forecast' and shows an arrow aimed high but missing its target and falling to the ground.
exploredCandidates.reason: 広告で収益を補うという期待が外れた点を、収益が実際に落ちる様子で視覚化するため。

evaluations.headline: 1. スペースXとテスラ統合協議 イーロン・マスク氏が委員会設置を表明（日経、ブルームバーグ、AXIOS等）2026/10/21
evaluations.reason: 強み：見出しが『統合に向けた委員会設置』と形式的意思決定を伝えている点を、そのまま文字通りの不整合（車をロケットにねじ込む試み）で可視化する発想は明快で読みやすい。視覚的な「物理的非互換性」を一場面で示せるため、タイトル無しでも趣旨が伝わりやすい。弱み：『プロダクトが実際に統合不可能』という前提は常識的だが、見出し自体がそれを明示しているわけではないため、事実関係の裏取りは不要だが、やや解釈（比喩）に依存する。絵に委員会の人数や設計図などの要素を入れすぎると小さいコマでは煩雑になる。

evaluations.headline: 2. AIバブルは「ほぼ間違いない」、シタデル創業者ケン・グリフィン氏（ブルームバーグ、AI関連）2026/10/21
evaluations.reason: 強み：『専門家がバブルを警告する』という言説と、マーケット（バブル）がその注意を無視して拡大する対立は視覚化しやすい。バブルが拡声器で“買え買え”と叫ぶ逆転は即読性がある。弱み：過去に同様の『風船＝バブル』メタファーを使った直近作があり（previousCartoon）、モチーフの使い回しに近い。新しさが不足しやすく、読者に既視感を与えるリスクが高い。見出し自体は発言を伝えているが、“バブルが主体的に買いを煽る”という擬人化は解釈の領域であり、新規性を出す工夫が必要。

evaluations.headline: 3. パリなどフランス各地に夜間外出禁止令 週末の暴動受け（国内etc）2026/10/21
evaluations.reason: 強み：外出禁止という公的措置（暴動抑制の意図）と、暴動の“エネルギー”が場所を変えて残るという逆説を、室内での“パロディ暴動”で表現するアイデアは視覚的に面白く、即時性がある。窓一列・バルコニー一つに絞れば小コマでも成立する。弱み：見出しは『外出禁止を発令した』事実を伝えるにとどまり、『暴動が屋内に移った』という具体的帰結は記事に明記されていないため、この因果を断定的に描くのは事実の補完に当たる。したがって地固め（grounding）は低めに評価した。表現としてはユーモラスだが、実際の出来事をそのまま再現するものではないことに注意。
unsupportedClaims: 外出禁止令が暴動を家庭内／窓辺に移行させたという因果関係

evaluations.headline: 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21
evaluations.reason: 強み：『市民の個人情報を守るべき警察』が『情報を落とす（流出させる）』という役割の逆転は、風刺の王道で即効性が高い。『傘（盾）に穴』という一つの道具で保護と漏洩を同時に示す視覚ターンは明瞭で小フォーマット向き。弱み：表現がやや直截的なので、デザインで工夫しないと平板に見える可能性があるが、安定したネタである。

evaluations.headline: 1. Netflix、売上高見通しが市場予想下回る－広告事業不振（ブルームバーグ、ロイター）2026/10/21
evaluations.reason: 強み：『広告事業で収益を補う』という期待と実際の不振という関係はそのまま視覚化しやすい。自販機が穴から小銭しか出さない比喩は即読性が高く、新聞の小コマでも成立する。弱み：メタファー自体（『収益マシンが漏れる』）はよく使われるため斬新味は低め。ビジュアルで差別化する（人物の表情や巨大な“予想”ポスターとの対比）工夫が必要。

prompt:
Create a single editorial cartoon for English-speaking newspaper readers.
News headline (source evidence, not lettering): 6. 22府県の警察 個人情報流出の恐れ（国内etc、Yahoo）2026/10/21
Satirical angle: Illustrate how a tiny technical slip can magnify into an uncontrollable exposure: a minuscule object becomes the seed of an enormous, destructive leak.
Scene: A tired desk clerk in a police office accidentally drops a single small USB stick onto the floor. At the point where it hits, a tiny damp circle forms and then explosively swells into a towering wave made of loose printed documents, loose USBs and discs that surges through the open station door. Two uniformed officers are swept off their feet on pieces of floating paper; one frantically tries to prop a small sandbag against the approaching wall of documents. The scene makes the small object the origin of an enormous physical flood.
Visual turn to show in the drawing: scale_shift: a tiny dropped device is visually amplified into a colossal, overwhelming flood of documents, turning a minor lapse into a massive disaster.
Depict this visible ironic reversal, not a literal reenactment of the reported event or a generic portrait. The turn must read without the title. A metaphor must not assert an unreported action or guilt.
Deliver the illustration alone. The page layout adds its title separately as real text. Do not render any title, subtitle, caption, heading or footer anywhere in this image, including the white margins. Do not write any Japanese characters in the image. Do not add text beneath the figures.
Strongly reference the pen-and-ink editorial cartoon work of Georges Bigot, Charles Wirgman and Charles Keene: observant human caricature, expressive faces and gestures, lively economical contours with deliberate changes in line weight, convincing clothing folds, and sparse hand-drawn hatching. Make these nineteenth-century draughtsmen the primary visual references throughout the drawing.
Create the original artwork for a newspaper illustration that will be printed using letterpress equipment and techniques from 150 years ago, circa 1876. Draw a deliberately composed, human-looking pen-and-ink original for an engraver to turn into a relief printing block. Use economical, clearly separated lines that remain legible when printed at small column size. Deliver the clean original drawing, without simulated aged-paper or printed-ink texture. Specific recognizable characters, expressive caricature, one clear visual joke, spare composition, natural asymmetry, varied purposeful contour lines. Avoid generic AI illustration conventions, glossy perfection, decorative clutter, stock robot imagery unless the joke specifically needs it, and irrelevant objects.
Black ink strokes on pure white paper ONLY. Clear outlines; express every shadow with sparse hatching, cross-hatching or stippled marks. Leave white paper visible between strokes. No gray fills, gradients, smooth shading, color, digital painting, photorealism, artificial paper texture or engraving filter effect. Keep most areas unshaded. Compact square composition, width:height exactly 1:1, complete subjects within the frame.
Design for a small newspaper column only about 64 mm wide. Use one clear visual joke with no more than two main figures and one essential prop. Remove secondary people, inset maps, small labels and ornamental detail. Render NO letters, numbers, symbols that resemble writing, speech bubbles, signs, stamps or pseudo-text anywhere in the image. Ignore ALL label or written-word instructions implicit in the headline, angle and scene except the one specified text element above. Never use fine print or tiny characters. Do NOT draw the Japanese title, a caption, a border, watermark or signature inside the image; the title will be typeset separately outside the artwork. Treat the scene as satire, and do not invent additional factual allegations beyond the supplied headline.
